design_philosophy.archetype: Tactical Intelligence & Executive Clarity (Palantir Workbench x McKinsey Report)
core_principles: Provenance-first affordances: AI proposes, humans verify, code guards truth
Strict node visual separation: PROPOSED (Amber dashed) vs VERIFIED (Emerald solid)
Visible evidence gaps highlight missing canonical evidence in coral-red border callouts
Zero-fluff enterprise dark slate color palette with tactical cyan accents

layout_and_grids.sidebar: w-64 bg-[#0E1420] border-r border-[#243044] h-screen sticky top-0 flex flex-col justify-between p-4
layout_and_grids.topbar: h-14 border-b border-[#243044] bg-[#0E1420]/80 backdrop-blur-md px-6 flex items-center justify-between sticky top-0 z-40

auth.layout: Centered dual-panel dark slate gateway with pilot enterprise selector and clearance status check

career_profile.layout: Graph node summary + Track segmentation tabs (civilian / military / intellectual_property) with toggleable PROPOSED vs VERIFIED views

resume_upload.layout: Drag-and-drop parser dropzone + live structured extraction inspector displaying confidence scores and extracted evidence nodes

opportunities.layout: Target Role/Org selector + Job Description analyzer breaking requirements into Tier 1 (Must-have) through Tier 4 (Nice-to-have)

evidence_map.layout: Centerpiece 5-column mapping matrix: Requirement -> Tier -> Evidence Matches -> Match Strength (%) -> Representation Weight + Gap Callouts ('No sufficient canonical evidence')

representation.layout: Generated Resume canvas with interactive per-claim hover tags linking directly to canonical evidence node provenance

validation.layout: Resume Contract Quality Gate results dashboard showing automated pass/warn/fail policy checks before human signoff

admin_pilot.layout: Pilot Lifecycle management dashboard with tenant usage, parsing queue stats, evidence coverage metrics, and system audit logs

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly build using JavaScript (.js / .jsx) files as specified in project stack.
Add 'data-testid' to every interactive button, link, form input, tab, and key metric component.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications (located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js or similar).
Never use fully transparent backgrounds on headers or overlays; use dark frosted glass 'bg-[#0E1420]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#243044]'.
Ensure 'PROPOSED' nodes are clearly distinguished by amber dashed borders and 'VERIFIED' nodes by emerald solid borders.
Ensure the Evidence Map highlights missing canonical evidence with visible Coral/Red border gap boxes.
Keep typography high-density, sharp, and readable using IBM Plex Mono for badges/metrics and Plus Jakarta Sans for headers.
